sentence_stem: If I had studied harder last year,
correct_completion: I would be a better engineer today.
full_sentence: If I had studied harder last year, I would be a better engineer today.
acceptable_variants: I would be working in a better job now.
I would have more career options now.

options.text: I will be a better engineer tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: 'Will' belongs to first conditionals with real future possibilities, so it does not match the unreal past condition in 'had studied'.

options.text: I studied harder and became an engineer.
options.why_wrong: This reports what happened in the past, so it does not give the hypothetical result that the conditional requires.

options.text: I would be a better engineer today.
I would have been a better engineer yesterday.
options.why_wrong: 'Yesterday' points to the past, but the result of this mixed conditional is in the present, so the time reference does not fit.

grammar_focus: Mixed conditionals: past perfect in the if-clause with 'would' plus base verb in the main clause for a present result
explanation: A mixed conditional combines a past perfect condition with a present result. The main clause uses 'would' plus a base verb and a present time reference such as 'today'.
translation: Se eu tivesse estudado mais no ano passado, eu seria um engenheiro melhor hoje.
